name: Login Layout (dotfiles)
description: Login screen only: the time and date in one of eight layouts (a panel, a card, a band or just the clock, on either side), with the user list moved out of their way and the panel clock hidden while the list shows; the panel can be glass (blurred) or solid. The password step is left as GNOME draws it. Installed and configured by scripts/16-loginLayout.sh.
